Initial release of freshbooks-curl skill.

- Query FreshBooks data (invoices, clients, estimates, payments, expenses, projects, time tracking) from a shell via cURL and rotating OAuth token.
- No need to run the freshbooks-mcp server; use directly in scripts or on machines without MCP.
- Handles OAuth2 token rotation and multiple FreshBooks resource identifiers.
- Includes setup and troubleshooting instructions in SKILL.md.
- Provides command examples for listing, reading, and writing FreshBooks resources from the shell.
